crossRefs.note: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…

translations.web: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
translations.bsb: So Potiphar’s wife kept Joseph’s cloak beside her until his master came home.
translations.kjv: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
translations.asv: And she laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
